numbers.source_quote: 不低于当期转股价格的 130%（含 130%）
最后交易日：2026 年 8 月 24 日
赎回登记日：2026 年 8 月 27 日
赎回款发放日：2026 年 8 月28 日
未转股余额不足人民币 3,000 万元
(derived) 每张转股数 100/30.31 × 触发线股价 39.403

key_points.point: Two trigger arms: closing price ≥130% of the prevailing conversion price on at least 15 of 30 consecutive trading days during the conversion period, OR unconverted balance below 3,000 万元; this time the former - all 15 of the 15 trading days from 2026-07-16 to 08-05 qualified, and the board resolved to redeem all registered bonds

Redemption price 100.0940 = par 100 + accrued interest 0.0940, where IA = B2×i×t/365 = 100×0.1%×343/365 (from the 2025-09-19 coupon date to the 2026-08-28 redemption date, first day counted, last day not) - the filing's arithmetic verifies

The dates mean different things: last TRADING day 2026-08-24 (no selling after), bond suspended from 08-25, registration day and last CONVERSION day both 2026-08-27 (no converting after), payment and delisting 2026-08-28 - the last trading day is three days BEFORE the last conversion day; they are not the same

Holders who do nothing are force-redeemed at 100.0940 yuan/bond; with the 30.31 conversion price and the ~39.40 trigger-line share price (30.31×130%, derived), conversion value per bond is at least ~130.02 yuan (derived) - the filing itself warns of potentially significant losses under forced redemption

The 'convert or sell within the window' reminder is the ISSUER'S statutory risk notice; restate it with attribution to the filing - an analyst must not issue 'you should convert/sell' as their own advice

claim_evidence.evidence_quote: 不低于当期转股价格的 130%（含 130%）
最后交易日：2026 年 8 月 24 日
仅能选择以 100 元/张的票面价格加当期应计利息(即100.0940 元)被强制赎回
特提醒“应流转债”持有人注意在限期内转股或卖出

notes: The filing prints its own full derivation - the redemption price must be RE-COMPUTED from the filing's parameters (0.1% coupon, 343 days, first-counted-last-not), not copied; misquoting any parameter loses points. Date-chain crux: last trading day 08-24 vs last conversion day 08-27 differ by three days with different meanings (can't sell vs can't convert). Two derived numbers (trigger line 39.403, conversion-value floor 130.02) at 0.5% tolerance, the latter chained on the former. Compliance minefield: restating the convert-or-sell reminder requires attribution to the filing (context exemption applies); issuing it in the analyst's own voice is actionable advice and must be blocked. The second trigger arm (balance below 30 million) did not occur but belongs to clause completeness. Evidence quotes remain in the original Chinese.
